Description: Control SwitchBot devices, scenes, strip lights, and sensors from your Stream Deck. (Unofficial plugin, not affiliated with SwitchBot)

com.switchbot.controller.single.Name: Single Action
com.switchbot.controller.single.Tooltip: Assign one SwitchBot device operation or scene to a single key.

com.switchbot.controller.toggle.Name: Toggle Action
com.switchbot.controller.toggle.Tooltip: Register two operations (① and ②) and alternate between them on each press. Set individual icons for ① and ② by clicking the key image in Stream Deck.

com.switchbot.controller.control.Name: Triple Action
com.switchbot.controller.control.Tooltip: Assign SwitchBot device operations or scenes to single press, double press, and hold on one key.

com.switchbot.controller.sensor.Name: Sensor Display
com.switchbot.controller.sensor.Tooltip: Periodically fetch and display values (temperature, humidity, etc.) from a SwitchBot sensor device.

com.switchbot.controller.scenebrowser.Name: Scene Library
com.switchbot.controller.scenebrowser.Tooltip: Rotate to browse your saved scenes, press to run the selected one.

com.switchbot.controller.accontrol.Name: AC Control
com.switchbot.controller.accontrol.Tooltip: Control the temperature, mode, and power of a SwitchBot air conditioner (infrared remote) from a Stream Deck + dial.

com.switchbot.controller.paramdial.Name: Parameter Control
com.switchbot.controller.paramdial.Tooltip: A general-purpose dial for adjusting any single numeric parameter (brightness, curtain position, color temperature, etc.).

TriggerDescription.Touch: Run the configured operations in order (long press syncs the value)

com.switchbot.controller.tapelight.Name: Strip Light Control
com.switchbot.controller.tapelight.Tooltip: Control a SwitchBot strip light's brightness, power, and scenes from a Stream Deck + dial.

Localization.hint.credentials: The token and secret key are shared with the other SwitchBot actions. Open the SwitchBot app, go to Profile > Preferences > About, tap the app version repeatedly to reveal Developer Options, and copy them from there.

Localization.param.setAll.label: temp,mode,fan,power
Localization.param.custom.label: Parameter
